thread:
mira: heads up — after the 09:30 canary deploy we're seeing a bunch of SSO failures. Users land on MFA screen and get stuck in a loop, cookies not being set. Audit shows KMS decrypt errors for assertion JWE. Anyone else seeing this?
alex: saw the alert, coming in now. which canary?
deploy-bot: Deployment started: canary v2.14 -> prod by julio at 2026-03-23T09:30:12Z :rocket: 
sam: can you paste the idp-proxy/auth logs? quick grep should reveal the decrypt error line.
mira: paste of the last few lines from idp-proxy right now:
```
2026-03-23T09:31:02Z idp-proxy ERROR auth: decrypt_envelope failed: kms:DecryptResourceNotFound: alias/rw-inference-key-prod
2026-03-23T09:31:02Z idp-proxy WARN auth: session cookie not set, user=alice@example.com err=EKEY
2026-03-23T09:31:03Z idp-proxy ERROR saml: assertion_jwe_decrypt failed; upstream idp returned 500
```
alex: that kms alias missing is suspicious — did we rotate keys this morning? @julio
julio: i ran a scheduled rekey earlier. I created a new key id and intended alias mapping, but I flipped a flag in the infra script to propagate only to us-east-1. if eu-auth uses alias lookup in eu region it might not see the alias yet.
sam: ok that explains decrypt failures in eu region. scim deprovision events look unrelated but i see some sessions not cleaned up (users deprov -> still showing active). likely sessions couldn't be verified because decrypt failed.
mira: MFA loop makes sense — idp can't decrypt assertion so it falls back to reauth, then fails again. we need a mitigation. roll back the canary or force idp-proxy to use the previous key id?
alex: mitigation options: 1) rollback canary immediately (fast) 2) rebind alias in eu region so decrypt succeeds (requires infra approval) 3) temporary config patch to skip JWE and use signed assertion (more risky). i'd vote rollback until alias is fixed.
julio: I can push alias to eu now. running: `aws kms create-alias --alias-name alias/rw-inference-key-prod --target-key-id 1234-xxxx`
mira: ping oncall to approve cross-region alias write?
alex: oncall approval not needed for create-alias, but we should record the action. please paste output when done.
julio: done, returned: `Alias arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:111222333:alias/rw-inference-key-prod created` 
security-scan-bot: Security scan note: dependency jwe-lib 2.3.1 flagged CVE-2025-0123 (low severity) — recommend patch but not related to decrypt errors.
sam: after alias creation, i'm seeing decrypt success lines in eu logs: `decrypt_envelope succeeded key=arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:111:key/1234-xxxx`
mira: confirm — users report they can now login and MFA loop cleared. rolling back canary not needed now.
alex: good catch. follow-ups: 1) add a pre-deploy integration test that validates alias propagation across regions 2) add an alert rule for kms:DecryptResourceNotFound frequency 3) add KMS rekey runbook step to verify alias sync and update audit log entry when alias is created.
mira: opening an incident ticket and assigning postmortem. quick notes: root cause = partial KMS alias propagation after scheduled rekey; symptom = SSO assertion JWE decrypt failures -> MFA loop + session cookie not set; mitigation = create alias in eu region; remediation/workitems = infra playbook update, integration test, audit log entries.
alex: i'll create the incident and assign owners. mira can you paste a timeline?
mira: timeline will be attached to ticket. thanks everyone — closing thread here but will follow up with postmortem + remediation plan. :thumbsup:
